title: A Burmese Loneliness: A Tale of Travel in Burma, the Southern Shan States and Keng Tung
author: Major C. M. Enriquez
genre: Historical Ethnography & Travelogue of the Shan & Tai Kingdoms
description: Vivid historical and geographic chronicle by Major Colin Metcalfe Enriquez documenting his expedition across the Shan plateau, Taunggyi, Lake Inle, Mongnai, and Kengtung, providing detailed firsthand accounts of Tai palace ceremonies, traditional monastic life, ethnic diversity, and market exchanges.
